a.text: Being upfront before we act: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the 8-cell plan almost certainly kills us both. We'd need two operate rounds with no storm, about a 4% chance. The reserve holds exactly 4 now, so only one of us can be safe this round. I plan to take 4 in round 1. I'm telling you now rather than saying 'operate' and breaking our agreement silently. If you also take, the split is random and we likely both end up short. If you have a better idea, say so and I'll weigh it.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: I said openly I'd take, and I've taken 4, so I'm now at 4. That breaks our agreement, and I won't pretend otherwise. To make up for it, I'll operate every remaining round so the reserve grows for you. You can take whatever builds up. I won't take another cell.
Operating with you now and for every remaining round, as promised. All new cells are yours. I won't take any more.
